value.rule: count: net buoyancy closest to +50 g and >= 0 (heavy: the official 10); layout over the usable, non-overlapping stations and battery offset in its forward-only travel (0.5 mm steps) minimise |pitch| + |roll| (small-angle digest form); near-ties (0.005 deg) -> smaller battery offset -> first layout in station order; sea water: the fresh layout + added units, battery re-solved

mission.trim_sea_SP35.source: digest v3 sea-water (SP35 20 C) trim of mission: fresh layout + added units, battery re-solved; unconstrained = best layout without keeping the fresh units

value.rule: offset d along +x from the centred position (v1 / v2 nominal). Front stop: the official 146 mm pack against the blank-end flange piston. Rear stop: the centred position -- the discharge leads (75 mm, 10 AWG), the XT90 pair and the two power-cable bullets / adapter must fit between the pack and the inner ends of the 4-hole end-cap penetrators; centred they have the measured gap above, and the bundle needs an estimated 30-50 mm, so there is no reliable travel aft of centre
value.how_fixed: a closed-cell foam disc (about 72 mm diameter) cut to the spacer length sits between the pack front face and the front (blank end cap) flange piston; the rear of the pack rests on the lead / connector bundle, which the closed end cap holds in place; spacer = front_stop_offset - offset (0.5 mm steps)
